_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/petty-alloc.jsx PettyCash (L12-117) + PettyClaimForm (L376-474). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source — same pattern as ap/billing-strings.json. crumbSection/crumbScreen render the breadcrumb. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, baht U+0E3F, le U+2264 in overLimit/modalSubtitle). Values in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json.phrases — they render honest Thai via tp() (tp returns the Thai key itself for lang th / on a phrases miss) and are flagged for the morning i18n mint (petty-i18n.apply.json, wei-approved:B-257). cancel + status header reuse existing DICT keys (common.cancel / common.status) via t(), not this file.
